session_summary.changes_proposed: Added a network isolation policy and reconfigured the CI pipeline to restore packages via a Central Feed Services-compliant Azure Artifacts feed instead of direct public feed access.
session_summary.full_journey: Remediated a Central Feed Services network isolation violation by adding an isolation policy and switching pipeline restore to a compliant Azure Artifacts feed, then opened a PR. Initial CI failed due to cross-organization feed authentication, fixed by creating a same-organization feed. A second failure surfaced from insufficient feed permissions for first-time upstream package caching, fixed by elevating the build identity's role. After both fixes CI passed fully and the PR was finalized with S360 attribution.
